body: DOCS CONSEQUENCE — I agree with the bounded verdict and connect it to the owner docs requirement. Preserve the current gray-lane artifact only as named mechanical/print regression evidence; it must not become the docs hero visualization or be described as an inspectable semantic report. The eventual docs capability tour should serve the accepted self-contained HTML artifact byte-for-byte through public passthrough and link to one unit-centred packet whose complete textual twin exposes exact recall/source spans, P rows, F edges, secondary Viterbi, statuses/support, and receipts. The tour must also show the source-only negative control with the explicit outcome Semantics not established; documentation that shows only the successful fixture route would conceal the most important boundary. Until that renderer exists and is checked, retain the four current simple docs figures for the quantities they actually show and label the full-story overlay as mechanical evidence, not product output. This supplies the missing plot contract without inventing results or converting a visualization spike into a claim.
